title: Just Decide Already
description: For when you've researched something to death. It compares your options, exposes which criteria actually matter, calls out false distinctions and forces a decision.
promise: For the moment when you've researched something so much that you have somehow become less capable of choosing.
what_it_does: It compares your options, exposes which criteria actually matter, identifies false distinctions and forces a decision framework.
when_to_use: You've got a comparison spreadsheet and still no answer.
You keep reopening a decision you already made.
what_to_give_it: What you've learned so far. Messy is fine.
What happens if you don't decide.
what_you_get: The two or three criteria that actually matter.
Which differences between the options aren't real.
A decision framework that ends in a choice.
